title: Neon Plasma Dandelion
description: A glowing spherical structure resembling a dandelion head composed of bright pink, purple, and cyan bubbles connected by luminous electric-blue stems to a central glowing red orb. The orb sits atop a dark stem against a dynamic background of streaking teal, purple, and black brushstrokes with floating translucent bubbles.
